titel: Teach Like an Orangutan! What Makes These Great Apes Such Great Teachers? (Encore)

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst art19.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts

einzeiler: 红毛猩猩如何像人类u00a0一样教育它们的下一代
kurzfassung: 两位主持人前往苏门答腊岛观察红毛猩猩母亲如何教育幼崽。研究发现猩猩幼崽跟随父母生活多年并分阶段学习复杂的觅食技能。这种循序渐进的抚育方式为人类教学提供了有趣的启示。
stichpunkte: 红毛猩猩与人类共享约97%的DNA
幼崽会跟随父母生活长达近12年之久
小猩猩需要学习识别并准备两百多种食物
觅食教学从易到难从植物逐步过渡到猎物
猩猩母亲会允许幼崽拿走自己找到的食物
随着年龄增长幼崽必须学会独立寻找食物
红毛猩猩的长期育儿法启发了有效的教学技巧
beschreibung:
When Guy Raz needs help preparing to teach his "Faster-Class," Mindy decides the best "people" to teach him are… orangutans in the jungles of Sumatra? In this episode about orangutan intelligence, animal learning, and teaching, Mindy and Guy embark on a wild adventure to discover how orangutan moms teach their babies the skills they need to survive! Listen and discover how young orangutans spend years learning everything from how to find flowers and fruits to using tools! By connecting laughter to learning, this animal learning episode shows how some of the best lessons can come from the most unexpected teachers.
Observing orangutans in the wild, Guy learns an important strategy for his Faster-Class: be patient, don’t yell, and demonstrate! And when a mother orangutan shares a hard-to-find meal with both of her babies, Guy discovers another valuable lesson: break learning into manageable and digestible steps!
Get ready for a tree-climbing adventure full of hilarious chaos, clever science, and lots of laughter. From a disastrous Faster-Class filming session, to a crash landing in Sumatra, Mindy and Guy discover how orangutan moms make some of the best teachers in the animal kingdom! This is the Who, What, When, Where, Why, How, and Wow in the World of orangutan intelligence, animal learning, and the surprising science of teaching, brought to life with humor, curiosity, and a whole lot of WOW!
